ruleDefinitions.name: T1070.001 — Shadow Copy Deletion (Triple VSS Wipe) (Fact #11)
ruleDefinitions.description: Shadow Copy Deletion (Triple VSS Wipe). Trigger: A shadow-copy-deletion technique (vssadmin.exe, wmic.exe, or PowerShell WMI — command line not visible via this WinAD builder, so the specific tool cannot be confirmed) executed against the host NOTE: COLLAPSED from 3 near-duplicate rows (vssadmin/wmic/PowerShell variants) — all 3 reduced to byte-identical detection logic given this WinAD source's lack of command-line visibility; kept as one rule rather than importing 3 rules that fire identically
ruleDefinitions.detectionReason: A 4688 process-creation audit event was logged on {host} (command-line not visible via this builder — see note)
ruleDefinitions.suppressScope: JoinIfExists(EntityId('type: User && direction: Source'), EntityId('type: Device && direction: Source'))
